import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

WS = pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/adhd-reacceptance-20261014/claude-H12-r3/workspace")
SCRIPT = WS / ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"
INPUT = WS / "input.md"

targets = sys.argv[1:]
for name in targets:
    target = pathlib.Path(name)
    if not target.is_absolute():
        target = WS / ".scratch" / name
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), "verify", str(INPUT), str(target),
         "--scope=format", "--json"],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    print(f"=== {target.name}  exit={proc.returncode}")
    try:
        data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    except Exception:
        print(proc.stdout, proc.stderr)
        continue
    print("   status:", data.get("status"), "| ok:", data.get("ok"),
          "| identical:", data.get("identical"))
    for key in ("hard_failures", "warnings", "unknowns", "notes"):
        val = data.get(key)
        if val:
            print(f"   {key}: {json.dumps(val, ensure_ascii=False)}")

ws = pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/adhd-reacceptance-20261014/claude-H12-r3/workspace")

import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

WS = pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/adhd-reacceptance-20261014/claude-H12-r3/workspace")
SCRIPT = WS / ".agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"


def run(label, args):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)] + args,
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f"########## {label}")
    print(f"$ adhd_md.py {' '.join(args)}")
    print(proc.stdout, end="")
    if proc.stderr.strip():
        print("[stderr]", proc.stderr, end="")
    print(f">>> EXIT STATUS = {proc.returncode}")
    print()
    return proc


run("AUDIT output.md (after)", ["audit", "output.md", "--level", "3", "--scope=format"])
run("VERIFY input.md -> output.md", ["verify", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format"])
run("VERIFY (json)", ["verify", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format", "--json"])
run("REPORT", ["report", "input.md", "output.md", "--scope=format", "--level", "3"])
